title: Beatrix and the Postcard
author: Casper Joubert
blurb: Mirabel Underhill, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
